title: skills(objectstack-ui, objectstack-data): teach the aggregate × field-type rule and the multi-value dimension rule
body:
Fixes #24425
Clause-②: no

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — 对外发布的两个 skill 各补一条规则,规则只在 objectstack-ui 陈述一次,objectstack-data 只做交叉引用。① 数据集度量的 `sum`/`avg`/`min`/`max` 必须落在**已存储**的数值或布尔字段上;`formula` 字段是虚拟列(不落库),不管它声明的 `returnType` 是什么都会被拒 —— 要合计一个计算值,就把数存下来(用户录入、`summary` 汇总、或由 hook 维护的存储字段),或者把部件如实标成 `count`。② 多值字段(`multiselect` / `checkboxes` / `tags`,以及任何 `multiple: true` 的字段)不能当分组维度,数据集维度、cube 维度、引擎 `groupBy` 一视同仁 —— 改用按成员的 `$contains` 过滤(一个成员一个部件)或换单值轴。各配一个几行的例子(请假天数合计、按标签分布)。`rules/field-types.md` 的 `formula` 行加一句指向该规则。评测夹具加两条用例,`must_not_contain` 钉住错误答案必然写出的拼法。补丁轮(裁决 A 之后):`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 里该评测夹具的上限按实测值从 1102 移到 1229,行旁按文件自身惯例写入裁决原话与算术;契约复核的两处小修 —— 请假天数例子里存储字段另起名(`days_count`,公式留在表单上)并对它求和,评测 7 的 `must_not_contain` 补上 cube 维度拼法 `sql: 'tags'`。

**为什么改** — 维护者在 cloud 卡 2861 裁决 B 后的原话:「2861 这个应该是 skills 也要优化吧」。平台早已拒绝这两种写法(spec 的 aggregate × field-type 表、分析维度门与引擎 groupBy 门、以及 `os validate` 的 lint 腿),发布的 skill 却没教,AI 会先写出被拒的形状、再从拒绝里学。本 PR 把规则放到作者决定部件时已在读的位置(Dataset-Bound Widgets 的标准答案列表)。上限上移的依据是维护者 2026-10-19 对决策批次 369 第 1 项(字母 A)的裁决「其他同意」(卡上裁决评论 6259315766),按棘轮自身惯例「先付再抬」。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 四个文件:三个 `skills/**` 文本文件加棘轮脚本一行上限及其记录块;无平台代码,无 changeset(`skip-changeset`,`scripts/` 不发布)。token 棘轮在最终 head 全绿:`rules/dashboards.md` 6251/6252(余量 1),`rules/field-types.md` 3116/3158,`evals/analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json` 1229/1229(按实测钉死,余量 0);新增 token 全部由同文件内的无损折叠或删除他处已有陈述支付(下表逐条列出存活位置),评测夹具付到底后的余额由裁决抬上限补齐(+127)。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的两个 commit,无数据与运行时影响。

**席位意见** —

**你要做的** — 批准并手合(Tier H,`skills/**`):本 PR 保持 draft,由你手工合并。

The row `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json` in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` moves from 1102 to 1229, pinned AT the measurement taken on the final head (zero headroom). Arithmetic, in bytes because that is what the convention divides: on `origin/main` (`e22defb13`) the file was 4388 bytes → 1097 tokens (headroom 5). The existing text was folded losslessly to 3780 bytes → 945 tokens first (the description, the five existing `expected_output` strings, eval 2's note and prompts 1 / 3 / 4 tightened, every fact and every assertion kept — the round-1 estimate said "about 1020"; measured, it is 945); the two cases then add +1135 bytes, so the landed file is 4915 bytes → 1229 tokens; the 5 tokens of existing headroom are absorbed and the ceiling moves 1102 → 1229 (+127). Reproducible without the script: `wc -c` on the fixture answers 4915, and `ceil(4915 / 4)` is 1229. The record block beside the row mirrors the file's 「17310 允许增加」 convention; the shrink-only testimony above `CEILINGS` is untouched (`pnpm check:ratchet-remedy-authority` exit 0; `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs --self-test` exit 0, 79 cases). No other ceiling moves, no new fixture, no new gate.

## What this teaches, measured against `main` at e22defb13

**Rule 1 — a dataset measure's `sum` / `avg` / `min` / `max` needs a STORED field of an accepted type; a `formula` is virtual and refused whatever its `returnType` says.** Sources read: `packages/spec/src/data/aggregate-field-type-compatibility.ts` (the one table: numeric class plus booleans, `percent` not under `sum`, `min`/`max` also the temporal class; `formula` named as VIRTUAL in SQL storage); `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-compiler.ts` (`DATASET_INVALID` / 400 before any query is built); `packages/lint/src/validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.ts` (the authoring-time leg behind `os validate`); `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.dataset-measure-aggregate-field-type-refused.ts` (the remedy: store the value as a number and aggregate that). Worked example: leave days — `sum` over the `formula` `days_requested` (`end - start`) is refused; a stored `number` `days_count`, written by a `beforeInsert` / `beforeUpdate` hook (the `defineHook` event names of objectstack-data's data-hooks reference), is summed instead, so the example and eval 6's prompt (the formula stays on the form) agree.

**Rule 2 — a multi-value field cannot be a group-by dimension: dataset `dimensions`, a cube dimension and the engine's `groupBy` alike.** Sources read: `packages/services/service-analytics/src/structured-json-dimension-door.ts` and `packages/objectql/src/group-by-structured-json-door.ts` (`INVALID_FIELD` / 400 at both doors; the class is `isMultiValueField` in `packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts`: `multiselect` / `checkboxes` / `tags`, or `multiple: true` on `select` / `radio` / `lookup` / `user` / `file` / `image`; no bucket-per-member grouping exists). The route the rule names, one widget per member filtered `{ tags: { $contains: 'urgent' } }`, is a membership test on a dataset-bound widget too: `packages/services/service-analytics/src/contains-membership-sql.ts` lowers `$contains` on a multi-value or JSON-stored field as membership in the analytics where clause (`whereContainsMembershipSql` in `strategies/native-sql-strategy.ts`) and in the read scope; the engine path lowers it the same way.

Both rules live in `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`, Dataset-Bound Widgets, as two entries of the standardized-answers list (right after the computed-column entry). `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` cross-references from the `formula` row. `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` is untouched: its Detailed Rules line already points at the section. No new file, no platform code, no changeset.

## Evals

No in-repo eval runner exists: `git grep -l must_not_contain origin/main -- scripts packages/spec/scripts packages/lint` answers 0 files, no `package.json` script is named `eval`, and `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/README.md` describes the fixtures as scored by an assistant harness. The card's acceptance line "the eval cases pass with the skill's eval runner" is therefore unmet by construction; the fixture's validity is JSON validity (parsed with the ids 1–7 read back), the token ratchet and `check:skill-docs`.

- Case 6 (leave-days total): the prompt keeps the `formula` on the form, so a right answer stores the number under another name (the rule's example now does the same: `days_count`); `must_not_contain` `field: 'days_requested'` (a dataset measure or an inline aggregate over the formula) and `sql: 'days_requested'` (a cube measure over it) are what the wrong answer must spell; `must_contain` `number`.
- Case 7 (by-tag breakdown): `must_not_contain` `field: 'tags'` (a dataset dimension declared over the multiselect), `groupBy: 'tags'` (an inline aggregate or an engine query) and, since the patch round, `sql: 'tags'` (a cube dimension, `analytics.zod.ts`) are what the wrong answer must spell; a right answer filters `{ tags: { $contains: TAG } }` and never declares a dimension on `tags`; `must_contain` `$contains`.

## Acceptance notes

- PM assumption falsified: the card's `validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.ts` does exist on `main` — `git cat-file -e e22defb13:packages/lint/src/validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.ts` succeeds. It is the authoring-time leg of the aggregate × field-type contract and also carries the dimension leg (`dimension-json-stored-field-refused`, a dataset dimension over a JSON-stored or multi-value field, and a cube dimension over such a column), so `os validate` refuses both shapes at authoring time. Cited above by its real path.
- Observation, not filed (a stale code comment, no runtime effect; carrier: none): the module comment of `structured-json-dimension-door.ts` ("The multi-value route is a RECORD query's membership filter … It is not this service's own `where`") predates `contains-membership-sql.ts`, which now lowers `$contains` as membership in `NativeSQLStrategy.buildFilterClause` as well.
